name: Sofia wa Uso to Hikikae ni
original_name: ソフィアは噓と引き換えに
source:
Sofia, a girl with multiple personalities, is arrested as a suspect in the murder of a presidential candidate.
Philip, a psychiatrist, is assigned to interrogate her after she has closed her mind.
However, his remote location limits his investigative options.

Through the surveillance cameras, we meet four distinct personalities with secrets.
Why did the girl murder the presidential candidate?

Your guesses will determine the fate of the five personalities that lie dormant inside Sofia...
Multi-ending "interactive" mystery adventure game that unravels the thoughts of the five personalities that lie dormant inside her, and gets to the bottom of the case.
